brief.zh: 把像素按亮度分成两类：亮于分界 m 的一类，其余一类。算出两类各自的平均亮度，输出它们正中间的新分界。
brief.en: Split the pixels into two classes by brightness: those brighter than the boundary m, and the rest. Work out each class's average brightness and output the new boundary halfway between them.

hint.zh: 一类的平均 = 这一类像素的亮度之和 ÷ 这一类的像素数。<part-ref to="mean"></part-ref>除以的是全部像素数，两个平均相除就约掉了。
hint.en: A class's average = the sum of its pixels' brightness ÷ the number of its pixels. <part-ref to="mean"></part-ref> divides by the number of all the pixels, which cancels when one average is divided by another.

after.zh: 分两类、各求中心、再分：这是 k 均值的一步。重复几步，分界就停在两堆像素之间。
after.en: Split into two, find each centre, split again: that is one step of k-means. Repeat a few steps and the boundary settles between the two heaps of pixels.

t.zh: 没有人告诉机器哪些是前景、哪些是背景时，它能不能自己把像素分成几堆？
t.en: When nobody tells the machine what is foreground and what is background, can it split the pixels into heaps by itself?

t.zh: 一个办法：先随便定一条亮度分界，按它把像素分成两类，看看两类各自的平均，再挪分界。
t.en: One way: draw a boundary in brightness anywhere, split the pixels into two classes by it, look at each class's average, then move the boundary.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：按说明里的规则，算出挪一次以后的新分界。
t.en: Your task in this level: by the rule in the brief, work out the new boundary after one move.

desc.zh: 按分界 m 把值分成两类，输出两类平均值的正中间。
desc.en: Splits the values into two classes at the boundary m and outputs halfway between the two class averages.
